title: Review Branch Lease (v1)
description: Per-branch push lease written by scripts/reviews/lease to .ops-perl-lsp/review-leases/<sanitized-branch>.json. Keyed on BRANCH (mechanically knowable via `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`), NOT agent identity. Substrate for the 'one editing owner per branch' invariant (R3b hook + R5 lease-audit). Default TTL 120 min (matches xtask worktree_allocator DEFAULT_LEASE_MINUTES). This is durable filesystem state, not a comment marker (#3693 R1 FILE 5).

acquired_at_epoch.description: Unix seconds — the portable comparison field (verify/audit avoid `date -d`).

expires_at_epoch.description: Unix seconds — lease is expired when now >= this.
